candidates.label: Hour-of-difficulty forgiveness and the three left behind: Allah turned in forgiveness to the Prophet, Muhajireen and Ansar who followed him in the hour of difficulty after hearts nearly swerved; also forgave three left behind whose earth narrowed despite vastness and souls confined until certain no refuge from Allah except in Him, then He turned so they could repent
candidates.definition: In 9:117-118, Allah's forgiveness extends to the Prophet and the emigrant-helper community who accompanied him during extreme hardship after some hearts almost deviated; then specifically to three individuals left behind who experienced such intense constriction that earth felt narrow despite its vastness and their own souls pressed upon them until they realized there is no refuge from Allah except toward Him, at which point He turned to them so they could repent.

evidence.excerpt: لَّقَد تَّابَ ٱللَّهُ عَلَى ٱلنَّبِيِّ وَٱلۡمُهَٰجِرِينَ وَٱلۡأَنصَارِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّبَعُوهُ فِي سَاعَةِ ٱلۡعُسۡرَةِ مِنۢ بَعۡدِ مَا كَادَ يَزِيغُ قُلُوبُ فَرِيقٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ ثُمَّ تَابَ عَلَيۡهِمۡۚ إِنَّهُۥ بِهِمۡ رَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Laqad taba Allahu AAala alnnabiyyi waalmuhajireena waalansari allatheena ittabaAAoohu fee saAAati alAAusrati min baAAdi ma kada yazeeghu quloobu fareeqin minhum thumma taba AAalayhim innahu bihim raoofun raheemun: laqad taba emphasizes accomplished forgiveness; saAAati alAAusrati names the crisis without specifying it; kada yazeeghu acknowledges near-deviation without condemning; raoof-raheem pairing closes with tenderness.

evidence.excerpt: وَعَلَى ٱلثَّلَٰثَةِ ٱلَّذِينَ خُلِّفُواْ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا ضَاقَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ بِمَا رَحُبَتۡ وَضَاقَتۡ عَلَيۡهِمۡ أَنفُسُهُمۡ وَظَنُّوٓاْ أَن لَّا مَلۡجَأَ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّآ إِلَيۡهِ ثُمَّ تَابَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ لِيَتُوبُوٓاْۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ
evidence.rationale: WaAAala alththalathati allatheena khullifoo hatta itha daqat AAalayhimu alardu bima rahubat wadaqat AAalayhim anfusuhum wathannoo an la maljaa mina Allahi illa ilayhi thumma taba AAalayhim liyatooboo inna Allaha huwa alttawwabu alrraheemu: khullifoo indicates deliberate leaving-behind; dual constriction (earth + self); certainty of no refuge except in Allah produces the turning point; liyatooboo shows divine forgiveness enables human repentance not vice versa; alttawwab alrraheem as closing divine names.

Earth-narrowing and soul-constriction represent maximum hardship resolved by divine turning

candidates.notes: Overlap with mercy-and-forgiveness and hardship-and-ease. The three-left-behind narrative provides the most detailed phenomenology of repentance-psychology in the Quran: external pressure (earth narrowing) plus internal pressure (soul confining) plus cognitive breakthrough (no refuge except in Him) produces the condition for divine turning. Liyatooboo reverses expected causality: Allah turns first enabling their repentance.

candidates.label: Truthfulness companionship and comprehensive deed-registration: believers commanded to fear Allah and be with the truthful; Madinah people and surrounding Bedouins must not remain behind the Messenger or prefer themselves over him; every thirst, fatigue, hunger, ground-treading that enrages disbelievers, enemy-infliction, and expenditure small or large registered as righteous deed; Allah does not waste muhsineen reward
candidates.definition: In 9:119-121, after the repentance narratives, believers are commanded to maintain taqwa and keep company with the truthful; the community around Madinah is told not to stay behind the Messenger or value themselves above him; then an exhaustive registration system is described where every hardship endured and expenditure made in Allah's cause is recorded as righteous deed, for Allah does not allow the reward of those who do good to be lost.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ ٱتَّقُواْ ٱللَّهَ وَكُونُواْ مَعَ ٱلصَّـٰدِقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha wakoonoo maAAa alssadiqeena: dual command pairing taqwa with truthful companionship; maAAa implies sustained proximity not mere agreement.

evidence.excerpt: مَا كَانَ لِأَهۡلِ ٱلۡمَدِينَةِ وَمَنۡ حَوۡلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلۡأَعۡرَابِ أَن يَتَخَلَّفُواْ عَن رَّسُولِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَرۡغَبُواْ بِأَنفُسِهِمۡ عَن نَّفۡسِهِۦۚ ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمۡ لَا يُصِيبُهُمۡ ظَمَأٞ وَلَا نَصَبٞ وَلَا مَخۡمَصَةٞ فِي سَبِيلِ ٱللَّهِ وَلَا يَطَـُٔونَ مَوۡطِئٗا يَغِيظُ ٱلۡكُفَّارَ وَلَا يَنَالُونَ مِنۡ عَدُوّٖ نَّيۡلًا إِلَّا كُتِبَ لَهُم بِهِۦ عَمَلٞ صَٰلِحٌۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يُضِيعُ أَجۡرَ ٱلۡمُحۡسِنِينَ
evidence.rationale: Ma kana liahli almadeenati waman hawlahum mina alaAArabi an yatakhallafoo AAan rasooli Allahi wala yarghaboo bianfusihim AAan nafsihi: negative framing (ma kana) establishing behavioral impossibility for true community. Thalika biannahum la yuseebuhum thamaon wala nasabun wala makhmasatun fee sabeeli Allahi wala yataoona mawtian yagheethu alkuffara wala yanaloona min AAaduwwin naylan illa kutiba lahum bihi AAamalun salihun: six hardship types each individually registered. Illa kutiba lahum bihi AAamalun salihun universalizes the registration mechanism.

evidence.excerpt: وَلَا يُنفِقُونَ نَفَقَةٗ صَغِيرَةٗ وَلَا كَبِيرَةٗ وَلَا يَقۡطَعُونَ وَادِيًا إِلَّا كُتِبَ لَهُمۡ لِيَجۡزِيَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ أَحۡسَنَ مَا كَانُواْ يَعۡمَلُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wala yunfiqoona nafaqatan sagheeratan wala kabeeratan wala yaqtaAAoona wadiyan illa kutiba lahum liyajziyahumu Allahu ahsana ma kanoo yaAAmaloona: extends registration to financial contributions and terrain crossings. Liyajziyahumu Allahu ahsana ma kanoo yaAAmaloona promises optimal reward matching.

Truthfulness-companionship command follows repentance narratives suggesting that truthfulness is both the lesson learned and the ongoing requirement.

candidates.label: Knowledge-mobilization balance and divergent revelation effects: believers need not mobilize entirely; a group from each division must remain for deep religious understanding to warn returning people; adjacent disbelievers fought with visible harshness; each revealed surah increases believers in faith with rejoicing while adding filth to diseased hearts who die disbelieving; annual trials unmet by repentance or remembrance; hypocrites glance for observers then slip away with hearts turned; Messenger from among yourselves grieved by your suffering concerned for you kind merciful to believers; closing tawakkul confession
candidates.definition: In 9:122-129, the surah transitions from total mobilization to balanced knowledge preservation: a group from each division stays for tafaqqah fi al-din to warn their people on return; adjacent disbelievers are to be fought with visible harshness; the effect of revelation is shown to bifurcate communities: believers gain faith and rejoice while diseased hearts gain filth upon filth dying in disbelief; hypocrites face annual trials without repentance, glancing for observers before slipping away with divinely-turned hearts; the surah closes with the Prophet's characterization as one from among them for whom their suffering is grievous, concerned over them, kind and merciful to believers; final verse teaches the tawakkul confession when they turn away.

evidence.excerpt: ۞وَمَا كَانَ ٱلۡمُؤۡمِنُونَ لِيَنفِرُواْ كَآفَّةٗۚ فَلَوۡلَا نَفَرَ مِن كُلِّ فِرۡقَةٖ مِّنۡهُمۡ طَآئِفَةٞ لِّيَتَفَقَّهُواْ فِي ٱلدِّينِ وَلِيُنذِرُواْ قَوۡمَهُمۡ إِذَا رَجَعُوٓاْ إِلَيۡهِمۡ لَعَلَّهُمۡ يَحۡذَرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Wama kana almuminoona liyanfiroo kaffatan falawla nafara min kulli firqatin minhum taifatun liyatafaqqahoo fee alddeeni waliyunthiroo qawmahum itha rajaAAoo ilayhim laAAallahum yahtharoona: kaffatan negation prevents total militarization; tafaqqah establishes scholarly class function; warning-return cycle creates sustainable knowledge infrastructure.

evidence.excerpt: يَـٰٓأَيُّهَا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ قَٰتِلُواْ ٱلَّذِينَ يَلُونَكُم مِّنَ ٱلۡكُفَّارِ وَلۡيَجِدُواْ فِيكُمۡ غِلۡظَةٗۚ وَٱعۡلَمُوٓاْ أَنَّ ٱللَّهَ مَعَ ٱلۡمُتَّقِينَ
evidence.rationale: Qatiloo allatheena yaloonakum mina alkuffari walyajidoo feekum ghilthatan: proximity-based engagement priority; ghiltha demands visible deterrence.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا مَآ أُنزِلَتۡ سُورَةٞ فَمِنۡهُم مَّن يَقُولُ أَيُّكُمۡ زَادَتۡهُ هَٰذِهِۦٓ إِيمَٰنٗاۚ فَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُواْ فَزَادَتۡهُمۡ إِيمَٰنٗا وَهُمۡ يَسۡتَبۡشِرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Faamma allatheena amanoo fazadathum eemanan wahum yastabshiroona: revelation as faith-amplifier for healthy hearts.

evidence.excerpt: وَأَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ فِي قُلُوبِهِم مَّرَضٞ فَزَادَتۡهُمۡ رِجۡسًا إِلَىٰ رِجۡسِهِمۡ وَمَاتُواْ وَهُمۡ كَٰفِرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Waamma allatheena fee quloobihim maradun fazadathum rijsan ila rijsihim wamatoo wahum kafiroona: revelation as filth-amplifier for diseased hearts; death-state specification.

evidence.excerpt: أَوَلَا يَرَوۡنَ أَنَّهُمۡ يُفۡتَنُونَ فِي كُلِّ عَامٖ مَّرَّةً أَوۡ مَرَّتَيۡنِ ثُمَّ لَا يَتُوبُونَ وَلَا هُمۡ يَذَّكَّرُونَ
evidence.rationale: Awala yarawna annahum yuftanoona fee kulli AAamin marratan aw marratayni thumma la yatooboona wala hum yaththakkaroona: annual trial frequency met with zero response.

evidence.excerpt: وَإِذَا مَآ أُنزِلَتۡ سُورَةٞ نَّظَرَ بَعۡضُهُمۡ إِلَىٰ بَعۡضٍ هَلۡ يَرَىٰكُم مِّنۡ أَحَدٖ ثُمَّ ٱنصَرَفُواْۚ صَرَفَ ٱللَّهُ قُلُوبَهُم بِأَنَّهُمۡ قَوۡمٞ لَّا يَفۡقَهُونَ
evidence.rationale: Nathara baAAduhum ila baAAdin hal yarakum min ahadin thumma insarafoo sarafa Allahu quloobahum biannahum qawmun la yafqahoona: surveillance behavior exposing cowardice; heart-turning as consequence of non-understanding.

evidence.excerpt: لَقَدۡ جَآءَكُمۡ رَسُولٞ مِّنۡ أَنفُسِكُمۡ عَزِيزٌ عَلَيۡهِ مَا عَنِتُّمۡ حَرِيصٌ عَلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡمُؤۡمِنِينَ رَءُوفٞ رَّحِيمٞ
evidence.rationale: Laqad jaakum rasoolun min anfusikum AAazeezun AAalayhi ma AAanittum hareesun AAalaykum bialmumineena raoofun raheemun: shared origin (min anfusikum); grief at community suffering; eagerness for their welfare; kindness-mercy pairing directed specifically at believers.

evidence.excerpt: فَإِن تَوَلَّوۡاْ فَقُلۡ حَسۡبِيَ ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَۖ عَلَيۡهِ تَوَكَّلۡتُۖ وَهُوَ رَبُّ ٱلۡعَرۡشِ ٱلۡعَظِيمِ
evidence.rationale: Fain tawallaw faqul hasbiya Allahu la ilaha illa huwa AAalayhi tawakkaltu wahuwa rabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi: conditional turning-away triggers tawakkul confession; hasbiya-la ilaha-tawakkaltu-rabbu al-arsh four-part formula establishing complete reliance; Great Throne reference as cosmic authority anchor.
